answer: Attestations are aggregated into one signature over 11 distinct keys, and the aggregate must verify against each key's registered public value. A farm cannot fake the aggregate without controlling every key it names, and as a result paying the river bond on all of them and exposing each to the vault slash. Because the pigment audit verifies the aggregate, a single forged member invalidates the whole batch. The deposit is 90 dollars a seat. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
